    // Get the table element by ID
    var table = document.querySelector(\'table[Id^=\"icdCodesTable\"]\');

    // Initialize an array to hold the table data
    var tableData = [];

    // Check if the table exists
    if (table) {
        // Loop through each row of the table
        for (var i = 0; i < table.rows.length; i++) {
            // Initialize an array to hold the row data
            var rowData = [];
            
            // Loop through each cell in the row
            for (var j = 0; j < table.rows[i].cells.length; j++) {
                var cell = table.rows[i].cells[j];
                var cellText = \'\';

                // Check if the cell contains an input element
                var inputElement = cell.querySelector(\'input\');
                if (inputElement) {
                    cellText = inputElement.value.trim();
                } else {
                    cellText = cell.innerText.trim();
                }

                // Add the cell text to the row data array
                rowData.push(cellText);
            }
            
            // Add the row data to the table data array
            tableData.push(rowData);
        }
    }

    // Convert the table data to a JSON string
    var extractedTableData = JSON.stringify(tableData);

    // Return the extracted table data
    return extractedTableData;
}
